item.text: South Australia’s Independent Commission Against Corruption evaluated commercial grants administered by the industry and trade departments.
item.support: focused on commercial, investment, research and entrepreneurial grants schemes.

item.text: It examined policies, staff interviews and a sample of recipients, focusing on three programs supporting research, new businesses and exports.
item.support: conducting a sample audit of grant recipients for selected programs

item.text: The Commission found many sound features in grants management while identifying ways to strengthen controls against corruption.
item.support: the Commission was encouraged to find many sound features in the practices, policies and procedures underpinning grants management.

item.text: Its 29 recommendations addressed conflicts of interest, training, records, due diligence, information security and program review across the two departments.
item.support: Recommendations 1 - 15 are addressed to the Department for Industry, Innovation and Science

item.quote: Despite the exposure of these two departments to considerable corruption risks, the Commission was encouraged to find many sound features in the practices, policies and procedures underpinning grants management.
